value.rationale: Two-tier pricing on windmill networks is a natural network-design setting. Exact all-asymmetric global allocation plus an if-and-only-if edge abandonment boundary is a nontrivial structural classification for every s,r>=2. In particular the threshold depends only on total peripheral order M=sr while the positive regime remembers clique geometry; this is useful for deciding whether to buy any intra-community connectivity and cannot be inferred from a fixed-weight Kirchhoff calculation. The theorem does not claim a general graph-network design solution.
